---
title: "Resultados"
---

> Los resultados se generan ejecutando `R/04__Calculo_tasa_usura.R` y exportando `Salida/salida.xlsx`.

## Últimos resultados disponibles

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false

library(data.table)
library(openxlsx)
library(plotly)

# Leer salida generada por el script principal
calculos <- setDT(read.xlsx("Salida/salida.xlsx"))
calculos[, corte := as.Date(corte, origin = "1899-12-30")]

# Gráfico comparativo TIBC proyectada vs real
plot_ly(calculos, x = ~corte) |>
  add_lines(y = ~TIBC_p * 100, name = "TIBC Proyectada", line = list(color = "#E8C547", width = 2)) |>
  add_lines(y = ~TIBC_r * 100, name = "TIBC Real (SFC)",  line = list(color = "#4ECDC4", width = 2, dash = "dash")) |>
  layout(
    title = "TIBC: Proyectada vs Real",
    xaxis = list(title = "Corte"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Tasa (%)"),
    paper_bgcolor = "transparent",
    plot_bgcolor  = "transparent"
  )
```

## Tabla de resultados

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false

DT::datatable(
  calculos[, .(
    Corte       = format(corte, "%b %Y"),
    `TIBC Proy` = scales::percent(TIBC_p, accuracy = 0.01),
    `TIBC Real` = scales::percent(TIBC_r, accuracy = 0.01),
    `Usura Proy`= scales::percent(USURA_p, accuracy = 0.01),
    `Usura Real`= scales::percent(USURA_r, accuracy = 0.01),
    `Δ TIBC`    = scales::percent(delta_TIBC,  accuracy = 0.001),
    `Δ Usura`   = scales::percent(delta_USURA, accuracy = 0.001)
  )],
  options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "tp"),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```
